_notes_space_sites: Space sites (docs/space-jobs-contract.md; design page docs/mockups/space-jobs; game/sim/Space/SpaceSites.cs). Places in a star system between the bodies: wrecks, debris fields, a station (later asteroids, anomalies, comets, lifepods). Rolled once per system from its seed (a hash, never sim.Rng): generation.count sites plus one station, each at a distance from the star within generation.orbit (map units) and an angle from the hash, at least clear_of_body from every body and spacing from every other site (tries attempts each, then given up). weights: the kind of each rolled site. Knowledge per player: Detected (a long-range scan reaches it: a grey contact and its size), Identified (a SiteScanCommand within identify_range map units of it, taking the kind's scan_seconds × the sweep_time lever × 1.3 while the sensors are down; leaving range calls it off), Spent (worked out; it drifts out of the system spent_seconds later unless a ship is there or on its way). The station is Identified from the start and never spent. kinds: id (a SiteKind in snake case), name (on the card), letter (the contact's label: Derelict C-3), scan_seconds, size [min, max] (1 small .. 5 huge, shown while only Detected), variants (variant id: weight; known derelicts: earth / trader / native), origin (variant id: the card's words), hazardous (no work there below the hull's critical band), hazards (the card's list), alongside (seconds to come alongside × the alongside_time lever, then one debris roll: chance percent for hull [min, max]), away_table (the ship_status away_team table its boarding uses; none = no away team), research [min, max] (what a boarding's data core is worth there, by the site's hash), restore_power (seconds of Engineering work, or kits patch kits at once; a known derelict), logs (seconds once powered: latinum and research [min, max] by the hash), reactor (a known derelict's reactor: seconds after coming alongside until it fails, and the hull damage if the ship is still alongside then: the site is spent), sweep (a debris field: seconds of sweeping inside it; hull_every_seconds the hull loses hull percent; finds [min, max] things found spread over the sweep, always (found first, once each) and items (weights of the rest); a find that doesn't fit the hold waits until there is room: the sweep stops; the tractor must work; survivors from a lifepod by lifepod_survivors [min, max]). salvage: items the hold can carry: id, name, containers each, latinum a station pays, research a dropped one gives at a station or the colony's body. station: names, orbit (its distance from the star), dock_seconds (back to 100% hull and every system fixed), hire (crew a visit may hire: per_visit, latinum each; only up to the ship's starting crew), survivor_latinum (paid for each survivor dropped who doesn't join the crew). colony_reach_seconds: a colony ship's side jobs only offer sites within this flight of the colony's body. All numbers are placeholders.

origin.explorer: a survey ship that was destroyed
